finalists.label: Metastatic Malignant Mesothelioma
finalists.why: Strong for evidence, including nodular growth and calretinin immunoreactivity, with no against evidence.

finalists.label: Metastatic Disease
finalists.why: Evidence of nodular growth and neoplastic proliferation, but less specific to mesothelioma than Metastatic Malignant Mesothelioma.

finalists.label: Calretinin-positive Neoplasm
finalists.why: Specific evidence for calretinin immunoreactivity, but less comprehensive than Metastatic Malignant Mesothelioma.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen due to its strong and specific for evidence, including nodular growth and calretinin immunoreactivity, which decisively establishes its mesothelial origin.

contradict_spans: Epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures

support_spans: nodular growth appeared on the mid third of the tongue
Neoplastic subepithelial proliferation, consisting of epithelioid cells in the tongue

contradict_spans: Neoplastic cells immunoreactive for calretinin, confirming mesothelial origin

support_spans: Immunoreactive for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, Wilms tumor protein 1
